ideas.title: Your Typing Rhythm Is a Digital Fingerprint
ideas.angle: Explain that AI can now identify you with 99% accuracy just by the timing between your keystrokes, even if you are anonymous. This forces viewers to comment their 'typing speed' to see if they are 'identifiable' and creates a high-retention 'tech-paranoia' loop.

hook.en: Your typing rhythm is tracking you.

ideas.reason: Privacy-related 'secrets' are currently outperforming general tech tips; the concept of 'behavioral biometrics' is a trending fear-based curiosity hook with high VVSA.
sources: Digital Guardian: What is Keystroke Dynamics?
FBI Law Enforcement Bulletin on Biometric Identification

ideas.title: The Ghost Pixel Spying on Your Emails
ideas.angle: Show the viewer how to find the 'invisible 1x1 pixels' in their inbox that tell senders exactly when and where they opened an email. It provides an immediate 'Digital Survival' action by showing them the one setting to kill these trackers.

hook.en: Invisible pixels are spying on you.

ideas.reason: Actionable 'Digital Survival' content has a higher APV because viewers pause the video to follow the steps on their own devices.
sources: The Verge: How to block tracking pixels
Princeton University: Web Transparency and Accountability Project

ideas.title: See an AI's Secret Hidden Instructions
ideas.angle: A live 'interactive hack' where the viewer learns the 4-word phrase that forces an AI to reveal its secret system instructions. This turns the video into a challenge where users go try it on ChatGPT or Claude immediately.
ideas.reason: Prompt injection is a high-velocity viral topic in the 'Forbidden AI' niche, directly appealing to the 'Insane AI Breakthroughs' pillar.
sources: Stanford University: Research on Prompt Injection Attacks
Learn Prompting: Jailbreaking and System Prompts
